data.gender_notes: Dorothea is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Dorothea means 'gift of God' or 'gifted one'. In Christianity, Saint Dorothea is the patron saint of gardeners and martyrs. She is said to have hidden in a garden when persecuted for her faith, and was eventually discovered and beheaded. The name Dorothea carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dorothea usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dorothea total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: דורותיאה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: דורותיאה הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו במילים היווניות 'דורוס' ו'תיאה', שפירושם מתנה של אלוהים. השם משלב את המילים 'דורוס', שפירושו מתנה, עם הסיומת 'תיאה', שפירושها אלוהים. דורותיאה הוא שם שמשדר כוח רוחני וקשר לאלוהים, ומשמש כזכרון לתקופת השקמה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Δωροθέα
in_greek.long_meaning: Δωροθέα είναι το θηλυκό ισοδύναμο του αρσενικού ονόματος Δωρόθεος, που σημαίνει «δώρο του Θεού». Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές λέξεις «δωρον» που σημαίνει δώρο και «θεός» που σημαίνει Θεός. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Δωροθέα δεν αναφέρεται άμεσα, αλλά η έννοια της δωρεάς από τον Θεό είναι κεντρική στο χριστιανικό μήνυμα. Το όνομα Δωροθέα ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και διατηρήθηκε στη μεσαιωνική και σύγχρονη εποχή ως σύμβολο πνευματικής γενναιοδοσίας.

in_latin.name: Dorothea
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Dorothea origine Graeco, constat ex vocibus 'doron', quod donum significat, et 'theos', quod Deum significat. Nomen Christianum Dorothea Dei donum interpretatur, habens profundam significationem spiritualem. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Dorothea habebatur in honore virtutis et pietatis. Usus eius per saecula manet, dum significat gratiam et munificentiam divinam.

in_english.name: Dorothea
in_english.long_meaning: The name Dorothea originates from the Greek words 'doron', meaning gift, and 'theos', meaning God. It signifies a gift from God, conveying spiritual significance and divine favor. Historically, Dorothea has been used in Christian tradition to denote a person blessed with spiritual gifts and graces. The name gained popularity in the Middle Ages due to its association with several Christian saints, notably Saint Dorothea of Cappadocia. Today, Dorothea remains a revered name across Christian cultures, symbolizing faith, piety, and the grace of God.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dorothea holds a beautiful and meaningful connection to Greek mythology and Christianity. For the Greeks, Dorothea was a name that symbolized the gift of God or the gifted one. This connotation of the name magically transmits an aura of grace and divinity till date.
data.spiritual_significance: Dorothea, as a name, is deeply rooted in spiritual significance. For the Greeks, it represented a divine gift, a connection with the divine. In Christianity, Dorothea's name evokes the image of a devout and courageous believer, who remained steadfast in her faith in the face of adversity and was eventually martyred. This name offers an inspiring reminder of the enduring power of faith and courage. Whether one sees Dorothea as a symbol of Greek mythology or as a reminder of a valiant Christian martyr, the name continues to carry a profoundly spiritual resonance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dorothea: Greek origin meaning "gift of God", symbolizing the belief that every human being is a divine gift from God. Spiritually, it represents gratitude for the gift of life and a reminder to live in a manner worthy of the divine gift bestowed upon us.
